description: Input for the 436 Generator: case header, AFTAP certification history, Part 1 answers, CBA dates. The app validates this JSON, the actuary reviews it, and only approved JSON writes the .docx.

caseNumber.description: Text, leading zeros preserved, never a number.

dobf.description: Plan date of benefit freeze (plan level, not the BCV1.DOBF participant field).

facts.description: Facts the numbers cannot settle; the actuary confirms them. Used only for the Part 4 draft.

f4022Max.description: PBGC maximum guarantee amount for the (d)(3) cap, second prong.

history.description: One row per plan year, from the later of the plan adoption date and PY2007.

aftap.description: Certified AFTAP %, or the AFTAP stated in an AVR or Schedule SB where no certification exists.

certDate.description: Signed certification date. Null only when the AFTAP comes from an AVR or Schedule SB with no certification date.

ipsRef.description: Image Viewer document number for the certification or source.

kind.description: certified: specific %. range: a range certification (aftap is the low bound). late: certified on/after Oct 1 of its plan year. recertified: amended value; effective from the original certification date if material.

title: 436 Generator input JSON
